baseline_variability_calibration.cost_accounting: Charge calibration GPU-seconds separately in total evaluation cost; never subtract this cost from reported experiment expenditure or count calibration as timing pairs.
baseline_variability_calibration.independence: Calibration executions and evaluation executions are separate; evaluation outputs cannot set scales. Seeds 1000..1007 remain the eight fixed trajectories in every ensemble. Across-seed trajectory differences do not substitute for same-seed run-to-run variability.
baseline_variability_calibration.positive_margin_requirement: Both scales must be finite and strictly positive. Zero or unavailable variability prevents equivalence certification; never replace with epsilon, exact equality or a fabricated positive energy margin. Calibration failure requires a new sealed run with justified margins.
baseline_variability_calibration.protocol: Before observing any method outputs, run 20 independent baseline-only repetitions of the complete fixed eight-seed ensemble. For each energy metric, calculate sample variance across the 20 repetitions separately for each fixed seed, then pool the eight variances by their arithmetic mean. Define frozen scale S=sqrt(pooled variance/8). Scientific absolute margin is S kJ/mol; normalized absolute margin is 1. This is a prospective operationalization of one baseline Monte Carlo standard error for an eight-replica mean, not a supplied measurement or validated domain tolerance. Record all baseline measurements, scales and software/hardware identity before any method comparison.
baseline_variability_calibration.scientific_limitation: No calibration executed during sealing. Numeric kJ/mol margins and unconditional equivalence power are unavailable. Normalized margin 1 is a declared prospective assumption. This negative-result seal does not certify scientific equivalence or trajectory identity.
baseline_variability_calibration.status: unavailable; no baseline scientific variability measurements in permitted evidence

compute_budget_policy: Each budget is a separate per-arm gpu_s cap for one complete fixed eight-replica ensemble, not permission to change steps, sample frequency, replica count or seeds. Five timing pairs at each cap. Any cap overrun is censored failure with no completed-work speedup claim; retain result. No calibrated outcome-versus-compute curve exists; no numeric outcome forecast is supported. With predictions=[], no per-method forecast points exist.

confidence_rule.equivalence_decision: Family alpha=1-0.95=0.05. Two metrics, Bonferroni per-metric alpha=0.025, per-tail alpha=0.0125. For eight sorted paired differences D[1]..D[8], exact two-sided median interval is [D[1],D[8]]: each excluded tail probability is 1/256=0.00390625. Require entire interval strictly inside (-1,+1) for both normalized metrics at every evaluated budget. No lack-of-significance substitution. Ties use conservative bounds; unavailable calibration, incomplete pairs or invalid outputs cannot pass.
confidence_rule.joint_decision: Performance and both scientific equivalence decisions must pass. This seal has no feasible candidate, so no method success decision is scheduled.
confidence_rule.performance_decision: At each fixed budget sort five paired baseline_gpu_s/method_gpu_s ratios. Use exact one-sided binomial order-statistic lower bound for population median: smallest ratio, since P[Binomial(5,0.5)=0]=1/32 <=0.05. Require lower bound >1.05. All pairs must finish full scientific work; failures and censoring cannot be discarded. Budgets are separate prospective descriptive decisions; no pooled across-budget significance claim.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work benchmark: complete eight replicas, each 25000 steps, total 0.8 ns, with 100 energy samples per replica; no calibrated monotone scientific outcome curve versus GPU-seconds. Mean/final energy preservation is tested by paired statistical equivalence, not an invented scalar optimization target.

equivalence_metrics.name: mean_potential_in_baseline_variability_units
equivalence_metrics.quantity: Per replica, arithmetic mean of 100 potential energies sampled every 250 steps, kJ/mol, divided by frozen positive baseline mean-energy scale. Subtract paired method and baseline values in those units.
equivalence_metrics.source: intake/brief.md, Predictions 2, and intake/EXECUTION.json scoring_interface.scientific_acceptance: fallback is same-seed sequential run-to-run variability; no numeric variability supplied. Prospective baseline-only normalization defined in baseline_variability_calibration; tolerance is one positive baseline standard error, not a measured kJ/mol margin.

equivalence_metrics.name: final_potential_in_baseline_variability_units
equivalence_metrics.quantity: Per-replica final potential energy at step 25000, kJ/mol, divided by frozen positive baseline final-energy scale. Subtract paired method and baseline values in those units.
equivalence_metrics.source: intake/EXECUTION.json scoring_interface.scientific_outputs and intake/brief.md outcome-preservation hypothesis. Applying the baseline-variability fallback to final energy is an explicit prospective assumption; no published final-energy acceptance margin exists. Baseline-only normalization defined in baseline_variability_calibration.

evaluation_inputs.generation: Use pinned equilibrated coordinates without additional equilibration or minimization. hardware_controls.accounting: GPU-seconds = reserved GPU count times complete ensemble elapsed wall seconds, including idle, launch, transfer, synchronization and merge time. Equal hardware cost throughout; no multi-GPU discount.
hardware_controls.gpu_model: Use the same physical GPU as profile-packet.json; exact model unavailable in permitted evidence. Record device identity before evaluation and hold fixed across arms.

paired_seed_tests.analysis_unit: One independent seed-level paired difference per metric: median of the five timing-pair method-minus-baseline metric differences for that seed. Eight seeds give eight scientific samples; neither 100 correlated trajectory samples nor timing repetitions count as additional independent seeds.
paired_seed_tests.pairing: Match input, seed, software, GPU, initial coordinates, precision and deterministic-force setting across arms. Seed sets both velocities and Langevin integrator stream. Outputs remain stochastic despite fixed seeds.
paired_seed_tests.scope: Tests concern seed-population medians for mean and final energies. They do not establish equality of every trajectory or full time series. No bitwise or zero-tolerance requirement.

power.alternative_assumption: Independent seed blocks; for each seed the probability that both aggregated normalized paired energy differences lie strictly inside (-1,1) is at least 0.99. This is an unverified prospective assumption, not an observed effect or distributional fit.
power.derivation: With n=8 and two Bonferroni metrics at family alpha=0.05, exact two-sided intervals are sample extrema. All eight seed blocks inside both margins suffices; probability >=0.99^8=0.9227446944279201. Eight seeds preserve the supplied fixed ensemble and permit finite two-metric extrema intervals at this confidence. If alternative assumption is unsupported, label power unestablished; do not assert powered empirical equivalence.
power.status: conditional prospective design; empirical power unavailable without baseline calibration

scheduling_protocol: Budget order fixed ascending. At each budget generate five independent fair baseline-first/method-first choices from random.Random(271828) in loop order, retaining generator state across budgets. Execute arms sequentially on exclusive physical GPU; methods may only use authorized internal concurrency. Reset identical coordinates and paired seeds for each arm. No opportunistic reruns or removal of slow pairs.

splits.held_out_policy: No method code or evaluation output examined during sealing. Scientific evaluation executions held out from baseline variability calibration; no tuning or selection on evaluation outcomes. Profile supplies performance evidence only. Fixed published seeds are not claimed to be previously unseen.
splits.training: not applicable: no learning or dataset split

timing_scope.description: Complete eight-replica ensemble timer starts before any replica launch, integrator/context construction or setup/JIT. Include positions and velocities, all integration and energy reads, H2D/D2H transfers, launch and scheduling costs, synchronization, context teardown, child completion and result merge. Stop after synchronized completion of final replica and merge. Adapter must fence GPU before start and stop and join every child. Imports, PDB parsing, force-field/System construction and final JSON serialization are excluded symmetrically as in intake/EXECUTION.json. Never sum worker times as ensemble elapsed time.

warmup_protocol: One complete untimed fixed-work eight-replica ensemble per arm before measured pairs at each budget; initialize and dispose every context. Do not reuse warmed trajectory states. No within-trajectory steps discarded or added. Record warmup GPU-seconds separately. No warmup or method workload executed during sealing.
